title: The staff list has no bulk edit or filter by Technician
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Start on Settings, Staff.
custom_steps:
1. Open the staff list's filters.
  2. Tick two staff rows, if the list has row ticks.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • No filter for Technician is offered.
  • The filters are the same as before.

Step 2:

  • No action offers to change Technician for the ticked rows (if the list has no row ticks, there is no bulk action at all).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Technician Toggle", Confluence 977371146, version 17 (2 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 2 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11788, story SV-11882 (Story 4, Technician column and notice on the staff list)

  • Out of Scope: “Bulk editing or filtering staff by Technician. The staff list column is sortable only.”
